notes: City of Garland, TX (Dallas County), within city limits. Built by data/jurisidictions/run_garland.py (dcad_county.py + tx_pipeline.py). 67,706 parcels, $6.52B land. All values 2026. A 0.14 km2 sliver of the city in Collin County has no parcels of its own.

Values: Dallas Central Appraisal District's 2026 certified data files (current certified values with supplements, files of 2026-11-09), joined on GIS_PARCEL_ID to DCAD's parcel polygons (2026-11); both downloaded by hand from dallascad.org. DCAD's own codes are mapped to statewide classes with DCAD's crosswalk. Check: DCAD's taxable land on City of Garland accounts with a polygon is $6.5228B vs $6.5228B kept here.
City limits: Census TIGER/Line 2025 place 4829000; DCAD's City of Garland jurisdiction agrees on all but 11 / 8 accounts.

Exempt land dropped: DCAD's totally exempt accounts (1,345, which include every named public owner: City of Garland, Garland ISD, Dallas County, DART). 30 personal-property and 15 utility records are left off.

Condos: DCAD maps each condo unit onto the complex polygon, and those records are summed there (100 polygons, 1,644 records; Faulkner Point: 252 units). 499 leftover nominal common areas (343 ac) dropped like exempt land.
41 sub-500 sqft remnants hidden. Singularity sweep: 3 of 67,706 parcels, all genuine appraiser values (at most 4.6x the neighbourhood); land $/sqft tops out at $47.
Under 100k parcels: browser GeoParquet path, no PMTiles bake.

Parking is OSM delivered through Overture Maps (release 2026-10-21.0, --overture-only): 71 lots, 109.1 acres, $34.8M est. land value. OSM parking coverage in Garland is thin, so this undercounts. apply_parking_category.py tagged 1 parcel 'Parking Lot'.
Links: DCAD's account page for the account's division (dallascad.org/AcctDetailRes.aspx?ID=<account> for residential, AcctDetailCom.aspx for commercial).
